table.retrieve:
SELECT itemname= case item.printable WHEN 1 THEN item.name ELSE 'Counter Sale:'+LTRIM(RTRIM(max(item.customicode))) END,   
         aliasname=max(item.customicode),   
         packingdesc=max(item.packingdesc),   
         accname = max(dbo.accounts.name),   
         address = max(dbo.customer.address1),   
         address2=max( dbo.customer.address2),
			customercity=max(customer.city),    
         salesman=(select name from salesman where salesmancode=max(saleledger.smancode)),  
         saleinvcode = dbo.saleledger.saleinvcode,   
         headerno =max(dbo.saleledger.headerno),   
         date = dbo.saleledger.date,   
         invdiscperc = dbo.saleledger.discperc,   
         misccharges = dbo.saleledger.misccharges,   
         flatdisc = dbo.saleledger.flatdisc,   
         invsalestax = dbo.saleledger.salestax,   
         gcode = saledetail.gcode,   
         icode = saledetail.icode,   
         batch = max(saledetail.batch),   
         expiry = max(saledetail.expiry),   
         looseqty = sum(saledetail.looseqty),   
         bonusqty = sum(saledetail.bonusqty),   
         packqty = sum(saledetail.packqty),   
         packunits= max(saledetail.packunits),   
         saleprice= max(saledetail.saleprice),   
         discperc = max(saledetail.discperc),  
			itemflatdisc=max(saledetail.itemflatdisc),   
         salestax = max(saledetail.salestax),   
         Id = max(dbo.saledetail.IDENTITYCOL),   
         posted=saleledger.posted,   
         balance=0,   
         unitsalestax = max(saledetail.unitsalestax),   
         gstperc = max(saledetail.gstperc),   
         invgstperc =max(saleledger.invgstperc1),   
         custTaxRegno=max(customer.salestaxregno)  ,
			dbo.saleledger.custrefno,	
			dbo.saleledger.remarks,
			dbo.saleledger.printwaranty,
			dbo.saleledger.printbatch,
			custcode=saleledger.custcode,
			saleledger.printbalance
			
    FROM saleledger,   
         saledetail,   
         accounts,   
         customer,   
         item  
   WHERE ( dbo.saleledger.saleinvcode = :ar_SaleInvCode ) AND  
         ( dbo.saleledger.saleinvcode = dbo.saledetail.saleinvcode) AND  
         ( dbo.saleledger.custcode = dbo.accounts.acccode ) AND  
         ( dbo.customer.custcode = dbo.accounts.acccode ) AND  
         ( dbo.saledetail.icode = dbo.item.icode)  
GROUP BY saleledger.saleinvcode, 
			saleledger.date, 
			/*saleledger.headerno,*/
			saleledger.custcode, 
			saleledger.discperc, 
			saleledger.flatdisc, 
			saleledger.misccharges, 
			saleledger.printwaranty,
			saleledger.printbatch,
			saleledger.printbalance,
			saleledger.salestax, 
			saleledger.remarks,
			saleledger.posted,
			saleledger.custrefno, 
			saledetail.icode,
			saledetail.rowgroup, 
			saledetail.gcode, 
			item.name,
			item.icode,
			item.printable, 
			accounts.name
ORDER BY 
			dbo.saleledger.saleinvcode,
			max(dbo.saledetail.IDENTITYCOL)

objects.name: c_sumsalestaxval
objects.expression: sum(round( c_amount  *  gstperc * 0.01, 2) +  Round((looseqty+bonusqty) * unitsalestax ,2) for all)

objects.name: c_totaltax
objects.expression: Round(Round((Round(sum((round(c_amount,2) ) for all)  *  (1 - invdiscperc * 0.01) ,2) -  flatdisc  )  *  invgstperc  * 0.01,2) + sum(c_salestaxval for all) , 0)

objects.name: c_grosstotal
objects.expression: Sum((  looseqty   *  (saleprice - itemflatdisc)  )  *  ( 1 -  (    discperc * .01 )  )  -  (  salestax   *  looseqty ) )

objects.name: c_invsalestaxval
objects.expression: Round((Round(sum((round(c_amount,2) ) for all)  *  (1 - invdiscperc * 0.01),2) -  flatdisc  )  *  invgstperc  * 0.01,2)

objects.name: c_nettotal
objects.expression: /*Round ( Sum((  looseqty   *  saleprice  )  *  ( 1 -  (    discperc * .01 )  )  -  (  salestax   *  looseqty ) ) *  ( 1 -  invdiscperc  * .01 )  -  flatdisc  +  misccharges  +  invsalestax , 0)*/Round(Sum (  c_netamount for all ) -  flatdisc  + misccharges  + salestax , 0)  + Round(sum(c_salestaxval for all ) + Round((Round(sum((round(c_amount,2) ) for all)  *  (1 - invdiscperc * 0.01) , 2) -  flatdisc  )  *  invgstperc  * 0.01,2),0)

objects.name: c_amount
objects.expression: (  looseqty   * ( saleprice - itemflatdisc)  )  *  ( 1 -  (    discperc * .01 )  )  -  (  salestax   *  looseqty )
